senses.gloss: चेष्ट m. ‘moving’, a kind of fish (तपस्विन्), L.
चेष्ट n. moving the limbs, gesture, Mn. vii, 63
behaviour, manner of life, Hariv. 5939
चेष्टा f. (Pāṇ. ii, 3, 12) moving any limb, gesture, Mn. vii f.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c. (ifc. Ragh. ii, 43)
action, activity, effort, endeavour, exertion, ĀśvŚr. i; ŚvetUp. ii, 9 (ifc.), Mn. iv, 65; Bhag. &c.
doing, performing, Mn. i, 65
behaving, manner of life, Mn. vii, 194; KapS. iii, 51; VarBṛS. (ifc.) &c.
cf. अ-, नष्ट-, निश्-.
चेष्टा f. See ˚ट.
चेष्टक mfn. making effort or exertion, W.
चेष्टक m. a kind of fish (= ˚ट), L.
a kind of coitus.
चेष्टन n. making effort, W.
motion, Mn. xii, 120; MBh. xii, 6363; R.; BhP.
ifc. performing, KapS. i, 3
effort, exertion, W.
चेष्टयितृ mfn. one who sets in motion, MBh. xii, 1181.
चेष्टा—नाश m. ceasing of every motion, L.
destruction of the world, L.
चेष्टा—निरूपण n. observing any one's actions, W.
चेष्टा-पृथक्त्व-निवर्तिन् mfn. to be (or being) carried out by separate (repeated) acts, ĀpY.
चेष्टा˚र्ह (˚टार्˚) mfn. worthy of effort, W.
चेष्टा—वत् mfn. moveable, Suśr. iii, 5, 23
full of activity, active, W.
चेष्टित mfn. set in motion, W.
done with effort, exerted, W.
done, Śak. iii, 23/24 (v.l.), v, 9
frequented, Ragh. xi, 51
चेष्टित n. moving any limb, gesture, Mn.; Suśr.; VarBṛS.
चेष्टित n. doing, action, behaviour, manner of life, Mn.; MBh.; R.; KapS. iii, 59 ff.; Śak. &c. (ifc. f(आ). , Bhar. xxxiv, 118).
चेष्टितव्य n. impers. to be done or managed, MBh. xii, 4919.
